_comment: Decisions board — the single source of truth the master-orchestrator session maintains. The orchestrator regenerates this file as work lands. cat is one of: done | act | decide | plan | review. The three items below are EXAMPLES showing the format — replace them with your own. Open decisions.html (any static server) to view.

items.title: EXAMPLE — a shipped item (replace me)
items.context: Shows the shape of a completed lane: what landed and where. The orchestrator marks work done here once it is verified, not merely started.
items.rec: None — done. Kept for one cycle so the board shows recent wins.

items.title: EXAMPLE — waiting on the owner (replace me)
items.context: A genuine irreversible the proxy-PM gate stops on: a production deploy, a spend, sending on your behalf, or a real direction fork. Surfaced early so nothing hidden blocks progress.
items.rec: Recommendation, not a survey: state the single action you would take and ask for a yes.

items.title: EXAMPLE — in flight, autonomous (replace me)
items.context: Routine, low-risk work the orchestrator is executing now via a subagent lane — no gate needed. Moves to 'done' when verified.
items.rec: Proceeding autonomously; result relayed as it lands.
